adds.when: the repository publishes a package and its PR merged into develop

deploy:merge-wait.waits: the pull request is open and not merged

deploy:close.description: Record verified build completion, close the Story and remove its workspace
deploy:close.purpose: Both PR and no-PR completion record only completed contributions and fully realized features; the local matrix write must succeed before close completes

records.name: closed
records.holds: true

records.name: matrixVerified
records.holds: { commit, entries, unmatched }: completed architecture items and features; commit may be null for no-PR completion
